thread:
elaine_mktg: Heads-up — planning the external announce for next Weds. Need final changelog + docs links by EOD Tuesday so we can schedule the blog + social and wire the webinar signup page.
sam_eng: Working on changelog. Can we scope 'breaking changes' vs 'behavioural tweaks' separately? I can tag commits.
liya_prod: Yes please. Also need the final model/quantization notes for the FAQ — that'll affect the benchmark narrative.
elaine_mktg: Good call. Sam, can you add a short bullets section (2–3 lines each) for: changelog highlights, known regressions, migration notes?
sam_eng: Will do. ETA 8pm PST Tue. I'll post a Gist.
ben_sales: For inbound routing: we should add a hidden UTMs param for webinars so leads tag to SDR queue A (early adopters). Can marketing automate that?
elaine_mktg: Yep — we've got a mailmap template. @nora_ops can you confirm webhook to HubSpot picks up utm_campaign=orbit-announce?
nora_ops: Confirmed. webhook script already maps utm_campaign->lead_tag. I'll add SDR queue mapping: orbit-announce -> SDR_A.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging->prod at 2026-03-25T02:00Z. Canary windows: 10m after deploy.
liya_prod: Timeline note: don't publish docs links until post-canary. Marketing, we need a 'beta' flag on docs for the first 24h.
elaine_mktg: Copy. We'll schedule the blog to publish after canary green. Webinar promo goes out 6 hours after publish. Social snippets prepared.
sam_eng: Gist with changelog + short bullets: https://gist.github.com/example/abcd1234 — includes migration snippet and quantization caveats.
elaine_mktg: Perfect — pulling the links into the blog draft now. Final ask: can eng provide a one-slide benchmark snapshot (latency/cost) for press and webinar deck?
sam_eng: I'll export a single-slide PNG and attach to the Gist by 9pm PST.
ben_sales: Also please add the 'how to request dedicated capacity' line in docs — that drives sales ops.
liya_prod: Will add a small section in docs and link to the lead form.
elaine_mktg: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist for Tuesday EOD: changelog Gist (sam), docs draft with beta flag (liya), benchmark slide (sam), webhook mapping confirmed (nora_ops). I'll run a preflight on Wed morning and ping #launch.
ben_sales: :thumbsup:
sam_eng: On it.
